issues.title: Inconsistent theme styling
issues.description: Page frame uses light background tokens while inner sections use dark mode styling.
issues.evidence: Header and footer regions render with white backgrounds around dark card containers.
issues.suggestion: Set consistent dark theme tokens on the outer page layout and header/footer containers.
issues.triageNote: Confirmed: the scrolling content column hardcodes bg-[#ffffff] (DefaultPageLayout.tsx); header/footer bands are transparent so they showed the white column around dark bg-panel cards in dark theme. Fixed by swapping to the bg-panel surface token (same pattern as ds:Dialog/ds:DialogLayout fixes).

issues.title: Light theme background in dark mode
issues.description: Layout frame and canvas use light tokens instead of dark theme styling.
issues.evidence: Header and footer show white background with dark text surrounding dark content cards.
issues.suggestion: Apply dark background and typography tokens to the root page container.
issues.triageNote: Same root cause as pair-034: layout canvas hardcoded bg-[#ffffff], so the transparent header/footer bands rendered white in dark theme. Fixed by the same bg-panel token swap; light theme is pixel-identical (panel = white in light).
